in-villa-comforts:
Beyond the shared spaces

In-villa comforts.

From bedroom finishes to furnished interiors, explore the features in the sequence presented in the technical booklet.

01

Master & guest bedrooms

Imported tile flooring, acrylic emulsion or wood panelling, and POP ceilings.

02

Additional bedrooms

Wooden flooring, considered wall finishes and POP ceilings in Bedroom 1 and Bedroom 2.

03

Modular kitchens

Granite or composite counters, kitchen equipment and a treated water provision.

04

Master bath & powder room

Designer tiles, marble or granite counters, sanitary fittings and glass shower enclosures where specified.

05

Balconies

Anti-skid vitrified tiles and textured wall finishes for outdoor spaces.

06

Other bathrooms

Designer tile finishes, marble or granite counters, sanitary fittings and glass shower enclosures.

07

Staff accommodation

Dedicated staff rooms with ceramic tile flooring and oil-bound distemper finishes.

08

Doors, windows & wardrobes

Veneer-finished doors, modular wardrobes and aluminium-framed double glazing.

09

Electrical & lighting

24/7 electricity supply, copper wiring, modular switches, energy-efficient LED lights and exhaust fans.

10

Air conditioning

VRV air conditioning, with Daikin, Mitsubishi or equivalent equipment specified.

11

Heat pump

A heat pump system, with Jaquar or Intersolar equipment specified.

12

Television

Samsung, LG or equivalent television equipment is included in the specifications.

13

Handmade paintings

Handmade paintings and decorative lighting, including artwork on the double-height wall.

14

Bespoke interiors

Fully furnished bespoke interiors with beds and mattresses, sofas, a dining table and chairs, and easy chairs.
